preconditions.description: The number of people n is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of imbalanced people k is between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= n for x in return_value.split('\n')[1].split())
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 0 and n.
Exactly one person does not have any children.

postconditions.expression: sum(is_imbalanced(i, return_value.split('\n')[1].split()) for i in range(1, n+1)) == k
postconditions.description: The number of imbalanced people is exactly k.
